test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

Boy : Man :: Child : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

 
• A grown-up boy is usually called a man.
 
• Similarly, a grown-up child is usually called an adult.

Hence, "option 3" is the correct answer.
